text: Safety distances between hazardous installations and between hazardous installations and buildings, boundaries and ignition sources shall be established by the layout with the following minimum values until the QRA (HS-HAZ-0010) and the hazardous area classification (HS-HAZ-0008) determine other values: the minimum distances of NFPA 30 for the LDO tanks (2 x 3,800 m3, API 650); NFPA 850 for the oil-filled transformers (15 m to buildings and to other transformers or a fire barrier of 2 hour rating).
